Zoe: Heads-up: found a misleading example in chat function-calling docs. The example shows the function call arguments serialized as a string, e.g. "arguments": "{\"user_id\":123}". Our runtime and SDKs expect arguments to be a JSON object for structured routing. This causes some SDKs to generate string-typed params.

Miguel: Oh no, which file/PR?

Zoe: docs/reference/chat.md in PR #5580. Current example block:
```json
{
  "id": "msg-1",
  "role": "assistant",
  "content": null,
  "function_call": {
    "name": "lookup_user",
    "arguments": "{\"user_id\": 123}"
  }
}
```
This should be:
```json
{
  "id": "msg-1",
  "role": "assistant",
  "content": null,
  "function_call": {
    "name": "lookup_user",
    "arguments": {"user_id": 123}
  }
}
```

Hana: That string-vs-object subtlety breaks typed clients. I saw a customer bug where TypeScript snippets inferred arguments: string, so you had to JSON.parse() before passing to the SDK. Not great.

Kit: docs-bot posted the CI failure this morning: examples-lint flagged example_field_type mismatch on docs/reference/chat.md.

docs-bot: PR #5580  examples-lint  failed: example_field_type mismatch in docs/reference/chat.md. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/5580/logs

Miguel: Plan: Zoe/Hana 1 Zoe can update the MD examples to use an object literal for function_call.arguments. Hana can audit other chat examples (system messages, assistant function calls, SDK snippets) to ensure we consistently show objects, not strings. I'll also add a short migration note for SDK users.

Zoe: I'll open a tiny PR to fix the example and add a note: "Note: function_call.arguments should be a JSON object. Examples that serialize arguments as strings may cause SDKs to infer the wrong type." Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5587

Hana: I'll run a grep across docs/ and specs/openapi for occurrences of "function_call" and patterns like "arguments": "{ to catch other instances. I'll bundle fixes into a follow-up PR and regen snippets for TS/Python/Ruby.

Kit: Also, update the OpenAPI examples for the chat endpoint (specs/openapi/chat.yaml) so the snippet generator picks the object example as canonical. Otherwise regenerated snippets will still show the string shape.

Zoe: PR #5587 opened with the MD example fix and a small migration blurb. Local preview looks good.

docs-bot: PR #5587  examples-lint pending.

Hana: Found two more occurrences in specs/openapi/chat.yaml and docs/guides/function-calling.md. I'll prepare PR #5592 to standardize the examples and run snippet generation.

Miguel: Can we add a linter rule in examples-lint to detect when function_call.arguments is a quoted JSON string? That should be easy: parse example JSON and fail when arguments is a string that looks like JSON.

Kit: Good idea. I'll add a small unit test in examples-lint that parses examples and asserts typeof arguments !== 'string' for any function_call object. I'll add it to PR #5595.

docs-bot: PR #5592 opened by Hana  snippet regen pending. PR #5595 opened by Kit  examples-lint rule added. CI started.

Zoe: Verified staging: corrected example matches runtime, and TypeScript snippet now shows arguments: { user_id: number } instead of string.

docs-bot: PR #5587 merged  CI green. PRs #5592 and #5595 merged subsequently. All CI checks passed.

Miguel: Great. I'll update CHANGELOG: "docs(chat): ensure function_call.arguments are objects, standardize examples and add linter rule" and close the docs issue.

Hana: Added an internal note to the docs backlog to audit other "embedded JSON string" anti-patterns (e.g., trace metadata fields) so we catch similar issues proactively.

Zoe: Marking ticket resolved on the tracker. :white_check_mark:
